verdict.rationale: Paddle docs confirm sales teams can draft/send invoices with manual payment collection [paddle-docs-17], and dunning/payment recovery with automatic reminders exists for card-based subscriptions [paddle-docs-18][paddle-supp-dunning]. However, evidence doesn't show that these hosted invoices themselves support online payment collection with automatic reminder sequences tied to the invoice — the invoice flow is described as manual payment collection distinct from the automated dunning system, which applies to card-on-file subscriptions, not invoices. missing for 10: explicit documentation that hosted invoices include an online 'pay now' link plus automated reminder emails specifically for unpaid invoices, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this workflow.
